firstPlayerRule: The youngest player goes first, rolling the die to see who gets to take a turn.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are the same age, use the picker.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/, a scan with no text layer, rendered it to an image and read it. PDF page 1: "Play • The youngest player goes first, rolling the Die, which will determine who gets to take a turn!" © 2015 Patch Products, item 7846.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for players of the same age.
